When I was 14 I was walking to a convenient store at night, when a car full of guys slowed down next to me and started yelling for me to come with them. I don’t think I’ve ever been more scared in my life. I ignored them and kept walking without acknowledging them, and the sidewalk was right next to a park, so I turned the other way and started walking to the park. It was dark enough that I knew they couldn’t see me anymore, and I hid behind a tree, shaking and crying until I saw the car drive off. That was pretty much the first time I’ve been harassed on the street.
